comments.content: `page.viewportSize()` can return null (e.g., when the browser context is created without an explicit viewport, or in headless mode with `--no-viewport`). Calling `.width`/`.height` on it will throw a NullPointerException and abort the click. Guard against null, e.g. `ViewportSize vp = page.viewportSize(); int vw = vp != null ? vp.width : 0;` before computing scroll offsets.

The debug marker is injected at the page's document coordinates (x, y), but `page.mouse().move/click` operate in viewport coordinates. After the `window.scrollTo` above, the marker will be drawn at the wrong location (offset by the scroll amount), making the debug visualization misleading. Either draw the marker at viewport coordinates (x - scrollX, y - scrollY) or use `position: fixed`.

The catch block is misleading: `pressSequentially` is attempted first, and only if it throws do we fall back to `fill`. But the comment says "fill 失败，尝试 pressSequentially" (fill failed, try pressSequentially), which is the opposite of the actual order. Also, `fill("")` is called twice (once in try, once in catch) which is redundant. Please fix the comment and remove the duplicate clear.

Setting `systemPrompt = " "` (a single space) as a default is a code smell. If the column is nullable now, prefer `null` as the default and let callers handle absence explicitly. A space value can leak into prompts/logs and is hard to distinguish from a real value. Also, the corresponding change in `AgentServiceImpl` sets `" "` instead of `null`; if any downstream code checks `systemPrompt != null` to decide whether to include it, this will silently include a blank prompt.
